raw_context:
Sanacorp Pharmahandel
is a major pharmacist-owned cooperative and pharmaceutical wholesaler in Germany. Rather than acting as a conventional drug manufacturer with a proprietary catalog of medication brands, it functions as a full-service logistics provider stocking roughly 140,000 products from hundreds of global and regional pharmaceutical manufacturers.
European Commission
Product Lines and Cooperative Brands
mea® (Meine Apotheke):
Sanacorp's primary cooperative pharmacy brand and marketing framework, which includes exclusive
mea® private-label products
(such as over-the-counter health items and wellness goods) produced across Germany and Europe.
samtweich:
A specialized wellness and personal care private-label brand distributed through their cooperative pharmacy network.
Sanacorp Connect:
Digital infrastructure and management tools provided directly to partner pharmacies for inventory and ordering.
Sanacorp
Manufacturer Partners & Scope
Full-Line Distribution:
Distributes prescription pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter (OTC) medicines, medical devices, and cosmetics sourced from leading international and domestic drug manufacturers.
European Commission
Industry Relations:
Collaborates with major generic, biologic, and proprietary drug manufacturers globally (such as major names distributed in the EU like STADA, ratiopharm, Teva, and others) to maintain a delivery schedule of 3 to 5 times daily to local pharmacies.
